method: Real player MapStage at 1440x960 DPR1, 45-degree view, 30 placed tokens (28 miniatures rendered), 23 walls, 6 placed lights, 3 lanterns, heavy darkness, 8ft mist at 65%, rain/embers. Two passes, 7s stationary and 7s repeated Vanec lantern movement per case. Actual painted renderer frames counted, distinct from browser RAF. High preset unchanged while character geometry varies; separate Balanced comparisons retained. Hardware verified from WebGL renderer. No recording. Overrides exist only in isolated benchmark bundle. Cold samples with incomplete 3D scene (<500,000 color triangles) excluded and repeated after refit; 5090 Balanced repeated after clearing previous test player claim.
